type Flex - Round roughness 0.0003 ft is the rigid default

layers.title: Topology from connector walks
layers.query: FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(OST_DuctCurves | OST_FlexDuctCurves | OST_DuctFitting | OST_DuctAccessory | OST_DuctTerminal | OST_MechanicalEquipment).WhereElementIsNotElementType(); each ConnectorManager.Connectors where Domain == DomainHvac and ConnectorType is End or Curve; Connector.AllRefs names the connected owner. Equipment is cut out: its ports become group roots.

layers.title: Sizes and lengths
layers.query: Duct and FlexDuct: RBS_CALCULATED_SIZE, RBS_CURVE_DIAMETER_PARAM, RBS_CURVE_WIDTH_PARAM, RBS_CURVE_HEIGHT_PARAM, CURVE_ELEM_LENGTH; LocationCurve end points, FlexDuct.Points

layers.title: Roughness
layers.query: MEPCurveType.Roughness of each DuctType and FlexDuctType; 0.0003 ft is the Revit default

layers.title: Terminal design flow
layers.query: OST_DuctTerminal instances: GetParameters("PE_M_Grd_AirFlow") of the AirFlow spec, the first nonzero (CubicFeetPerMinute), else on its FamilySymbol

layers.title: Derived flow (pass 1)
layers.query: DuctNetwork.PassOne: terminal design flow summed up the tree from the one equipment port of each loop-free group

layers.title: Fan external static
layers.query: OST_MechanicalEquipment with HVAC connectors: LookupParameter("PE_M_Fan_ExternalStaticPressure") (InchesOfWater60DegreesFahrenheit) on the instance, else on its FamilySymbol; GetParameters("PE_M_Fan_AirFlowDesign") of the AirFlow spec, the first nonzero (CubicFeetPerMinute), else on its FamilySymbol

layers.title: Component pressure drop
layers.query: OST_DuctAccessory instances: LookupParameter("Pressure Drop") (InchesOfWater60DegreesFahrenheit) on the instance, else on its FamilySymbol

layers.title: Fitting geometry
layers.query: OST_DuctFitting: instance-to-symbol Angle parameter (Angle spec, exact origin retained), LookupParameter("Center Radius"), LookupParameter("Pe_C") (familyCoefficient); connector sizes; DuctNetwork derives rOverD (round elbows), inlet and aoOverA1 (explicit physical In/Out transitions), takeoff, mainDiameter, mainArea and abOverAc (fittings on a duct's curve connector)

layers.title: Fitting and accessory loss method
layers.query: RBS_DUCT_FITTING_LOSS_METHOD_SERVER_PARAM; ExternalServiceRegistry DuctFittingAndAccessoryPressureDropService GetServer(id).GetDataSchema(), Element.GetEntity(schema) string fields (ASHRAETableName, Coefficient); RBS_DUCT_PRESSURE_DROP

layers.title: Terminal pressure drop
layers.query: OST_DuctTerminal first HVAC connector: AssignedPressureDrop (InchesOfWater60DegreesFahrenheit), AssignedDuctLossMethod (writable only under SpecificLoss); catalog LookupParameter("PE_M_Grd_ExternalStaticPressure") on the instance, else on its FamilySymbol

layers.title: Revit systems and critical path
layers.query: FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(MechanicalSystem) where SystemType is SupplyAir, ReturnAir or ExhaustAir: IsWellConnected, BaseEquipment, BaseEquipmentConnector, PressureLossOfCriticalPath, GetCriticalPathSectionNumbers(), GetSectionByNumber(k) Flow, TotalPressureLoss, GetElementIds(); DuctSettings.NetworkBasedCalculations

layers.title: Model health
layers.query: DuctHealth.Assess per element and connector: open ends (caps excluded) with their neighbourhood (not on `roster` or `ids` reads), near misses, inline parts (an unconnected two-port part inside a straight duct, joined to the bounded reads), loops, stubs under 3 in, air-type changes at a joint, implausible sizes, default flex roughness, missing terminal flow and component drops, and Revit velocity of 2000 fpm or more
